-- BLADE SHAPES: width, straight height, tip height, thickness
--------------------------------------------------
local SHAPES = {
	shield  = {W = 1.36, RH = 0.72, TH = 0.62, Tip = "shield"},
	square  = {W = 1.3,  RH = 1.12, TH = 0,    Tip = "flat"},
	broad   = {W = 1.78, RH = 0.74, TH = 0.46, Tip = "round", Flare = 1.04},
	pointed = {W = 1.12, RH = 0.44, TH = 1.12, Tip = "point"},
	trench  = {W = 0.9,  RH = 1.05, TH = 0.5,  Tip = "shield"},
	heavy   = {W = 1.48, RH = 0.8,  TH = 0.56, T = 0.2, Tip = "round", Flare = 1.05},
	gem     = {W = 1.28, RH = 0.0,  TH = 1.28, Gem = true},
}

--------------------------------------------------
-- HIGH-POLY BLADE HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------
-- any 3D triangle from two wedges (thickness along the triangle's normal)
local function triangle(name, a, b, c, thick, color, mat)
	local ab, ac, bc = b - a, c - a, c - b
	local abd, acd, bcd = ab:Dot(ab), ac:Dot(ac), bc:Dot(bc)
	if abd > acd and abd > bcd then c, a = a, c
	elseif acd > bcd and acd > abd then a, b = b, a end
	ab, ac, bc = b - a, c - a, c - b
	local cr = ac:Cross(ab)
	if cr.Magnitude < 1e-6 then return end
	local right = cr.Unit
	local up = bc:Cross(right).Unit
	local back = bc.Unit
	local height = math.abs(ab:Dot(up))
	if height < 0.002 then return end
	local l1, l2 = math.abs(ab:Dot(back)), math.abs(ac:Dot(back))
	if l1 > 0.002 then wedge(name, Vector3.new(thick, height, l1), CFrame.fromMatrix((a + b) / 2, right, up, back), color, mat) end
	if l2 > 0.002 then wedge(name, Vector3.new(thick, height, l2), CFrame.fromMatrix((a + c) / 2, -right, up, -back), color, mat) end
end

local function curve(p0, p1, p2, n)
	local pts = {}
	for i = 1, n do
		local t = i / n
		local u = 1 - t
		table.insert(pts, Vector2.new(u * u * p0.X + 2 * u * t * p1.X + t * t * p2.X, u * u * p0.Y + 2 * u * t * p1.Y + t * t * p2.Y))
	end
	return pts
end

-- right-half outline of a blade: from top-center, around the side, to the bottom tip
local function outline(sh, hw, top)
	local RH, TH = sh.RH, sh.TH
	local bottom = top - RH - TH
	local pts = {}
	if sh.Gem then
		local mid = top - 0.36
		pts = {Vector2.new(0, top), Vector2.new(hw * 0.3, top - 0.05), Vector2.new(hw * 0.75, top - 0.2), Vector2.new(hw, mid)}
		for _, p in ipairs(curve(Vector2.new(hw, mid), Vector2.new(hw * 0.62, mid - TH * 0.3), Vector2.new(0, bottom), 6)) do table.insert(pts, p) end
		return pts, bottom
	end
	local flare = sh.Flare or 1
	table.insert(pts, Vector2.new(0, top))
	table.insert(pts, Vector2.new(hw - 0.08, top))
	for _, p in ipairs(curve(Vector2.new(hw - 0.08, top), Vector2.new(hw, top), Vector2.new(hw, top - 0.08), 2)) do table.insert(pts, p) end
	local sideEnd = Vector2.new(hw * flare, top - RH)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local t = i / 3
		table.insert(pts, Vector2.new(hw + (hw * flare - hw) * t, top - 0.08 - (RH - 0.08) * t))
	end
	table.insert(pts, sideEnd)
	if TH <= 0.01 then
		bottom = top - RH - 0.16
		for _, p in ipairs(curve(sideEnd, Vector2.new(hw * flare, bottom), Vector2.new(hw * flare - 0.2, bottom), 4)) do table.insert(pts, p) end
		table.insert(pts, Vector2.new(0, bottom))
	else
		local tip = sh.Tip or "shield"
		local ctrl
		if tip == "point" then ctrl = Vector2.new(hw * 0.5, top - RH - TH * 0.45)
		elseif tip == "round" then ctrl = Vector2.new(hw * flare * 0.98, bottom + TH * 0.12)
		else ctrl = Vector2.new(hw * flare * 0.82, top - RH - TH * 0.55) end
		for _, p in ipairs(curve(sideEnd, ctrl, Vector2.new(0, bottom), 7)) do table.insert(pts, p) end
	end
	return pts, bottom
end

-- fills one half of the blade (s = 1 right, -1 left) with triangles, curved into a scoop (dish) or a gem bulge
local function fillHalf(pts, s, hw, dish, bulge, thick, color, mat, name, simple)
	local function P(x, y)
		local z = dish * (x / hw) ^ 2
		if bulge then z = -bulge * (1 - math.abs(x) / hw) end
		return Vector3.new(s * x, y, z)
	end
	for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
		local A, B = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
		if simple then
			triangle(name, P(A.X, A.Y), P(B.X, B.Y), P(0, B.Y), thick, color, mat)
			triangle(name, P(A.X, A.Y), P(0, B.Y), P(0, A.Y), thick, color, mat)
		else
			local ax, bx = A.X / 2, B.X / 2
			triangle(name, P(A.X, A.Y), P(B.X, B.Y), P(bx, B.Y), thick, color, mat)
			triangle(name, P(A.X, A.Y), P(bx, B.Y), P(ax, A.Y), thick, color, mat)
			triangle(name, P(ax, A.Y), P(bx, B.Y), P(0, B.Y), thick, color, mat)
			triangle(name, P(ax, A.Y), P(0, B.Y), P(0, A.Y), thick, color, mat)
		end
	end
end

-- merges all parts of a temp model into one mesh (UnionOperation); keeps the wedges if CSG fails
local function mergeInto(target, tmp, name, mat, props)
	local parts = tmp:GetChildren()
	tmp.Parent = workspace
	local first = table.remove(parts, 1)
	local ok, u = pcall(function()
		return first:UnionAsync(parts, Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box, Enum.RenderFidelity.Precise)
	end)
	if ok and u then
		u.Name = name
		u.UsePartColor = false
		u.Material = mat
		u.Anchored = true; u.CanCollide = false; u.CanQuery = false; u.CanTouch = false; u.CastShadow = false; u.Massless = true
		if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do u[k] = v end end
		u.Parent = target
		tmp:Destroy()
		return u
	end
	warn("[ShovelModelBuilder] union failed for " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(u))
	table.insert(parts, 1, first)
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
		if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do p[k] = v end end
		p.Parent = target
	end
	tmp:Destroy()
	return first
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- BUILD ONE SHOVEL
--------------------------------------------------
local function build(d)
	M = Instance.new("Model")
	M.Name = d.Name
	local metal = d.Metal
	local trim = d.Trim or metal:Lerp(WHITE, 0.15)
	local accent = d.Accent or trim:Lerp(BLACK, 0.25)
	local metalMat = d.MetalMat or METAL
	local mp = d.Shiny and {Reflectance = d.Shiny} or nil
	local sh = SHAPES[d.Shape or "shield"]
	local W, RH, TH, T = sh.W, sh.RH, sh.TH, d.T or sh.T or 0.12
	local bladeColor, bladeMat = d.Blade or metal, d.BladeMat or metalMat
	local bp = {Reflectance = d.Shiny or 0, Transparency = d.BladeTransparency or 0}
	local edge = d.Edge or bladeColor:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4)
	local edgeMat = d.EdgeMat or bladeMat
	local ridge = d.Ridge or bladeColor:Lerp(BLACK, 0.22)
	local zf = {-(T / 2 + 0.025), T / 2 + 0.025}
	local bottomY = TOP - RH - TH

	---------------- GRIP ----------------
	local gripColor, gripMat = d.Grip or metal, d.GripMat or metalMat
	if d.GripType == "T" then
		part("GripTop", Vector3.new(1.15, 0.26, 0.26), CFrame.new(0, 1.62, 0), gripColor, gripMat, mp)
		part("ShaftTop", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.45, 0.18), CFrame.new(0, 1.4, 0), d.Shaft or rgb(140, 90, 55), d.ShaftMat or WOOD)
		for s = -1, 1, 2 do part("GripCap", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.32, 0.32), CFrame.new(s * 0.6, 1.62, 0), trim, metalMat, mp) end
		if d.Wrap then part("GripWrap", Vector3.new(0.7, 0.32, 0.32), CFrame.new(0, 1.62, 0), d.Wrap, SP) end
	else
		part("GripTop", Vector3.new(1.0, 0.24, 0.26), CFrame.new(0, 2.05, 0), gripColor, gripMat, mp)
		for s = -1, 1, 2 do
			part("GripSide", Vector3.new(0.22, 0.86, 0.26), CFrame.new(s * 0.25, 1.75, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 0.695), gripColor, gripMat, mp)
			part("GripCap", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), CFrame.new(s * 0.5, 2.05, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, PI / 4), trim, metalMat, mp)
		end
		if d.Wrap then part("GripWrap", Vector3.new(0.62, 0.3, 0.32), CFrame.new(0, 2.05, 0), d.Wrap, SP) end
	end
	part("TopCollar", Vector3.new(0.34, 0.3, 0.34), CFrame.new(0, 1.36, 0), trim, metalMat, mp)
	part("TopRing", Vector3.new(0.38, 0.07, 0.38), CFrame.new(0, 1.19, 0), accent, metalMat, mp)

	---------------- SHAFT ----------------
	local handle = part("Handle", Vector3.new(0.2, 1.72, 0.2), CFrame.new(0, 0.36, 0), d.Shaft or rgb(140, 90, 55), d.ShaftMat or WOOD, d.ShaftProps)
	if d.ShaftWrap then
		for _, y in ipairs({0.95, 0.72}) do part("ShaftWrap", Vector3.new(0.24, 0.14, 0.24), CFrame.new(0, y, 0), d.ShaftWrap, SP) end
	end
	if d.ShaftRings then
		for _, y in ipairs({0.45, 0.05}) do part("ShaftRing", Vector3.new(0.26, 0.07, 0.26), CFrame.new(0, y, 0), accent, metalMat, mp) end
	end
	part("BottomCollar", Vector3.new(0.34, 0.26, 0.34), CFrame.new(0, -0.55, 0), trim, metalMat, mp)
	part("BottomRing", Vector3.new(0.38, 0.07, 0.38), CFrame.new(0, -0.39, 0), accent, metalMat, mp)
	part("Socket", Vector3.new(0.3, 0.26, 0.24), CFrame.new(0, -0.74, 0), trim, metalMat, mp)
	for _, z in ipairs(zf) do tri("SocketTaper", 0, -0.86, z, -PI / 2, 0.18, 0.32, 0.05, trim, metalMat, mp) end

	---------------- BLADE (high-poly, merged into meshes) ----------------
	local hw = W / 2
	local pts, bottom = outline(sh, hw, TOP)
	bottomY = bottom
	local H = TOP - bottom
	local dish = sh.Gem and 0 or (d.Dish or 0.1)
	local bulge = sh.Gem and 0.12 or 0
	-- depth of a decoration so it never touches the curved blade:
	-- side -1 = front, 1 = back; layer 0,1,2... = stacking order; xmin/xmax = the |x| range it covers
	local function surf(x) return dish * (x / hw) ^ 2 - bulge * (1 - math.min(math.abs(x), hw) / hw) end
	local function Z(side, layer, thick, xmin, xmax)
		local base = side < 0 and (surf(xmin or 0) - T / 2) or (surf(math.min(xmax or 0, hw)) + T / 2)
		return base + side * (0.015 + layer * 0.035 + thick / 2)
	end
	local keep = M
	-- main plate
	local tmp = Instance.new("Model")
	M = tmp
	for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do fillHalf(pts, s, hw, dish, sh.Gem and bulge or nil, T, bladeColor, bladeMat, "Blade", false) end
	-- beveled rim (slightly bigger, thinner, behind the plate)
	local rimTmp = Instance.new("Model")
	M = rimTmp
	local e = 0.08
	local rimPts = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(pts) do table.insert(rimPts, Vector2.new(p.X * (hw + e) / hw, TOP - 0.03 - (TOP - p.Y) * (H + e - 0.03) / H)) end
	for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do fillHalf(rimPts, s, hw + e, dish, nil, T * 0.55, edge, edgeMat, "BladeRim", true) end
	M = keep
	local blade = mergeInto(M, tmp, "Blade", bladeMat, bp)
	mergeInto(M, rimTmp, "BladeRim", edgeMat, nil)

	if sh.Gem then
		for _, s in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
			part("GemShine", Vector3.new(0.05, H * 0.55, 0.03), CFrame.new(-hw * 0.3, TOP - H * 0.35, Z(s, 1, 0.03, hw * 0.1, hw * 0.5)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.35), WHITE, NEON, {Transparency = 0.4})
		end
	else
		-- center ridge on both faces
		for _, s in ipairs({-1, 1}) do tri("Ridge", 0, TOP - 0.05, Z(s, 2, 0.05, 0, 0.12), -PI / 2, 0.12, H * 0.8, 0.05, ridge, bladeMat, {Transparency = bp.Transparency}) end
		-- foot treads on the shoulders
		for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
			local x = s * (hw - 0.26)
			part("Tread", Vector3.new(0.36, 0.08, T + 0.12), CFrame.new(x, TOP - 0.03, dish * ((hw - 0.26) / hw) ^ 2), edge, edgeMat)
		end
	end

	---------------- DETAILS (layered, never touching another surface) ----------------
	local SIDES = {-1, 1}
	local edgeZ = surf(hw)
	local function rectY(f) return TOP - RH * f end
	if d.Rivets then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			part("RivetPlate", Vector3.new(0.36, 0.42, 0.04), CFrame.new(0, TOP - 0.2, Z(s, 0, 0.04, 0, 0.18)), trim, metalMat, mp)
			for _, y in ipairs({TOP - 0.09, TOP - 0.31}) do ball("Rivet", 0.12, Vector3.new(0, y, Z(s, 3, 0.12, 0, 0.06)), accent, metalMat) end
		end
	end
	if d.Bolts and RH > 0 then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for _, sx in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
				local x = W / 2 - 0.15
				for _, y in ipairs({TOP - 0.14, rectY(1) + 0.12}) do
					ball("Bolt", 0.12, Vector3.new(sx * x, y, Z(s, 3, 0.12, x - 0.06, x + 0.06)), d.BoltColor or accent, metalMat)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Plate and RH > 0 then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			part("ArmorPlate", Vector3.new(W * 0.7, RH * 0.55, 0.04), CFrame.new(0, rectY(0.42), Z(s, 0, 0.04, 0, W * 0.35)), d.Plate, metalMat, mp)
		end
	end
	if d.Teeth or d.Spikes then
		local big = d.Spikes
		local th, h = big and 0.12 or 0.08, big and 0.32 or 0.15
		local col = d.SpikeColor or bladeColor
		local sideN = big and 2 or 3
		for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
			for k = 1, sideN do
				local y = TOP - 0.1 - (RH - 0.16) * (k - 0.5) / sideN
				tri("Tooth", s * (hw + 0.02), y, edgeZ, s == 1 and 0 or PI, th, h, T * 0.9, col, bladeMat)
			end
			if TH > 0 then
				local ang = math.atan2(-(W / 2), s * TH)
				for _, t in ipairs(big and {0.35, 0.72} or {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}) do
					local x = hw * (1 - t)
					tri("Tooth", s * x, TOP - RH - TH * t, surf(x), ang, th, h, T * 0.9, col, bladeMat)
				end
			end
		end
		if big then
			tri("Spike", 0, bottomY + 0.05, 0, -PI / 2, 0.1, 0.4, T * 0.9, col, bladeMat)
			for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do tri("Spike", s * (hw - 0.06), TOP, edgeZ, PI / 2 + s * -0.6, 0.1, 0.35, T * 0.9, col, bladeMat) end
		end
	end
	if d.DoubleEdge then
		for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
			tri("Prong", s * (hw + 0.02), TOP - RH + 0.08, edgeZ, -PI / 2 + s * 0.75, 0.14, 0.5, T * 0.9, edge, edgeMat)
		end
	end
	if d.Patina and RH > 0 then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for _, p in ipairs({{-0.35, 0.3, 0.22, 0.16}, {0.3, 0.6, 0.18, 0.2}, {-0.1, 0.85, 0.15, 0.12}}) do
				local ax = math.abs(p[1])
				part("Patina", Vector3.new(p[3], p[4], 0.03), CFrame.new(p[1], rectY(p[2]), Z(s, 0, 0.03, math.max(0, ax - p[3] / 2), ax + p[3] / 2)), d.Patina, SAND)
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Weave and RH > 0 then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for i = 0, 3 do for j = 0, 2 do
				if (i + j) % 2 == 0 then
					local x = -W / 2 + W / 8 + i * W / 4
					local ax = math.abs(x)
					part("Weave", Vector3.new(W / 4 - 0.05, RH / 3 - 0.05, 0.03), CFrame.new(x, TOP - RH / 6 - j * RH / 3, Z(s, 0, 0.03, math.max(0, ax - W / 8), ax + W / 8)), d.Weave, SP)
				end
			end end
		end
	end
	if d.Hazard and RH > 0 then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for i = 0, 5 do
				local x = -W / 2 + W / 12 + i * W / 6
				local ax = math.abs(x)
				part("Hazard", Vector3.new(W / 6, 0.16, 0.035), CFrame.new(x, TOP - 0.12, Z(s, 0, 0.035, math.max(0, ax - W / 12), ax + W / 12)),
					i % 2 == 0 and rgb(250, 200, 40) or rgb(25, 25, 25), SP)
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Bands then
		local cols = d.Bands
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for i, c in ipairs(cols) do
				part("Band", Vector3.new(W * 0.96, RH / #cols, 0.03), CFrame.new(0, TOP - RH / #cols * (i - 0.5), Z(s, 0, 0.03, 0, hw)), c, SP)
			end
			for k, c in ipairs(d.TipBands or {}) do
				local f = 1 - (k - 1) * 0.28
				tri("TipBand", 0, TOP - RH, Z(s, k, 0.03, 0, hw * f), -PI / 2, hw * 0.96 * f, TH * 0.95 * f, 0.03, c, SP)
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Cracks then
		local rnd = Random.new(#d.Name * 7)
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for i = 1, 7 do
				local y = TOP - 0.12 - rnd:NextNumber() * (RH + TH * 0.6)
				local maxX = (y > TOP - RH) and (hw - 0.18) or math.max(0.05, hw * (1 - (TOP - RH - y) / math.max(TH, 0.01)) - 0.18)
				local x = (rnd:NextNumber() * 2 - 1) * maxX
				local ax = math.abs(x)
				part("Crack", Vector3.new(0.05, 0.18 + rnd:NextNumber() * 0.22, 0.03), CFrame.new(x, y, Z(s, 1 + (i % 2), 0.03, math.max(0, ax - 0.2), ax + 0.2)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rnd:NextNumber() * PI), d.Cracks, NEON)
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Drips then
		for _, p in ipairs({{0, bottomY - 0.12, 0.16}, {hw + 0.03, TOP - RH * 0.8, 0.12}, {-hw - 0.03, TOP - RH * 0.5, 0.11}, {0.25, bottomY + 0.3, 0.1}}) do
			ball("Drip", p[3], Vector3.new(p[1], p[2], surf(p[1])), d.Drips, NEON)
		end
	end
	if d.Runes then
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			for _, y in ipairs({TOP - 0.22, TOP - 0.47, TOP - 0.72}) do
				part("Rune", Vector3.new(0.14, 0.14, 0.03), CFrame.new(0, y, Z(s, 3, 0.03, 0, 0.1)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, PI / 4), d.Runes, NEON)
			end
			for _, sx in ipairs({1, -1}) do
				part("Rune", Vector3.new(0.05, 0.3, 0.03), CFrame.new(sx * 0.34, TOP - 0.35, Z(s, 1, 0.03, 0.25, 0.43)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, sx * 0.4), d.Runes, NEON)
				part("Rune", Vector3.new(0.05, 0.22, 0.03), CFrame.new(sx * 0.3, TOP - 0.62, Z(s, 1, 0.03, 0.22, 0.38)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -sx * 0.4), d.Runes, NEON)
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Thorns then
		for i, y in ipairs({1.0, 0.6, 0.2, -0.2}) do
			spike("Thorn", CFrame.new(0, y, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, i * 2.1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -PI / 2.6), 0.32, 0.1, d.Thorns, metalMat)
		end
	end
	if d.Core then
		local cy = sh.Gem and (TOP - 0.36) or (TOP - RH * 0.55)
		for _, s in ipairs(SIDES) do
			ball("Core", 0.3, Vector3.new(0, cy, Z(s, 3, 0.3, 0, 0.15)), d.Core, NEON)
			if d.Trefoil then
				for k = 0, 2 do
					local a = k * 2 * PI / 3 + PI / 2
					part("Trefoil", Vector3.new(0.2, 0.26, 0.03), CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * 0.3, cy + math.sin(a) * 0.3, Z(s, 1, 0.03, 0, 0.45)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, a - PI / 2), d.Core, NEON)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if d.Crystals then
		local col, mat = d.Crystals, d.CrystalMat or GLASS
		local cp = {Transparency = 0.1}
		for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
			spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(s * (hw - 0.05), TOP - RH * 0.35, edgeZ) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 1.0), 0.6, 0.2, col, mat, cp)
			spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(s * (hw - 0.1), TOP - RH * 0.85, surf(hw - 0.1)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 1.35), 0.42, 0.15, col, mat, cp)
			spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(s * 0.18, -0.6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 0.5), 0.45, 0.15, col, mat, cp)
		end
		if d.BigCrystals then
			for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
				spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(s * 0.1, 1.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 0.9), 0.55, 0.16, col, mat, cp)
				spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(s * (hw - 0.1), TOP - RH * 0.6, surf(hw - 0.1)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -s * 1.6), 0.75, 0.22, col, mat, cp)
			end
			spike("Crystal", CFrame.new(0, bottomY + 0.1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(PI, 0, 0), 0.55, 0.2, col, mat, cp)
		end
	end
	if d.Icicles then
		for _, p in ipairs({{-hw + 0.05, TOP - RH, 0.35}, {hw - 0.05, TOP - RH, 0.3}, {0.12, -0.7, 0.28}, {-0.12, -0.7, 0.22}, {0.14, 1.15, 0.25}}) do
			local z = (p[2] < -0.72) and surf(p[1]) or 0
			spike("Icicle", CFrame.new(p[1], p[2], z) * CFrame.Angles(PI, 0, 0), p[3], 0.1, d.Icicles, ICE, {Transparency = 0.05})
		end
	end
	if d.Frost then
		for _, p in ipairs({{0, 1.44, 0.4, 0.14}, {0, -0.49, 0.41, 0.12}, {0.15, 2.19, 0.5, 0.1}, {0, 0.6, 0.27, 0.1}}) do
			part("Frost", Vector3.new(p[3], p[4], p[3]), CFrame.new(p[1], p[2], 0), d.Frost, SAND)
		end
	end
	if d.Wings then
		for _, s in ipairs({1, -1}) do
			for k = 0, 2 do
				part("Feather", Vector3.new(0.75 - k * 0.15, 0.2, 0.06 + k * 0.012), CFrame.new(s * (0.45 + k * 0.08), -0.58 - k * 0.14, k * 0.02) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s * (0.55 - k * 0.25)),
					d.Wings, SP)
			end
			part("WingTrim", Vector3.new(0.7, 0.07, 0.1), CFrame.new(s * 0.45, -0.48, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s * 0.55), trim, metalMat, mp)
		end
	end
	if d.Halo then
		for k = 0, 11 do
			local a = k * PI / 6
			part("Halo", Vector3.new(0.26, 0.07, 0.07), CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * 0.45, 2.55, math.sin(a) * 0.45) * CFrame.Angles(0, -a + PI / 2, 0), d.Halo, NEON)
		end
	end
	if d.GripGem then
		for _, z in ipairs({-0.19, 0.19}) do
			part("GripGem", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.06), CFrame.new(0, 1.36, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, PI / 4), d.GripGem, NEON)
		end
	end
	if d.Chunks then
		for _, p in ipairs({{hw + 0.35, TOP - 0.2, 0.28}, {-hw - 0.3, TOP - RH * 0.7, 0.22}, {0.2, bottomY - 0.35, 0.2}}) do
			part("RockChunk", Vector3.new(p[3], p[3] * 0.8, p[3]), CFrame.new(p[1], p[2], 0) * CFrame.Angles(0.5, 0.7, 0.3), d.Blade or metal, BASALT)
		end
	end

	---------------- FX ----------------
	if d.Glow then light(blade, d.Glow, d.GlowRange or 7) end
	for _, fx in ipairs(d.Particles or {}) do emitter(blade, fx[1], fx[2]) end

	local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
	hl.Name = "Outline"
	hl.FillTransparency = 1
	hl.OutlineColor = BLACK
	hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
	hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	hl.Parent = M

	M.PrimaryPart = handle
	M.WorldPivot = handle.CFrame
	local built = M
	M = nil
	return built
end

function Builder.Build(onlyNames)
	local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local folder = RS:FindFirstChild("ShovelModels") or Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "ShovelModels"
	folder.Parent = RS
	local ok, fail = 0, {}
	local only
	if onlyNames then only = {} for _, n in ipairs(onlyNames) do only[n] = true end end
	for _, d in ipairs(Builder.DESIGNS) do
		if only and not only[d.Name] then continue end
		local good, res = pcall(build, d)
		if good then
			local old = folder:FindFirstChild(d.Name)
			if old then old:Destroy() end
			res.Parent = folder
			ok += 1
		else
			table.insert(fail, d.Name .. ": " .. tostring(res))
		end
	end
	return ok, fail
end

return Builder

local sg = script.Parent
local window = sg:WaitForChild("Window")

local box = window:WaitForChild("Input")
local order = 0
local history, hIndex = {}, 0

-- the toggle button lives in its own always-visible ScreenGui
local tg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
tg.Name = "AdminToggle"
tg.ResetOnSpawn = false
tg.DisplayOrder = 200
tg.Parent = sg.Parent
local toggleBtn = sg:WaitForChild("ToggleTemplate"):Clone()
toggleBtn.Name = "Toggle"

local function add(text, color)
	for line in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
		order += 1
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
		l.Font = Enum.Font.Code
		l.TextSize = 15
		l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		l.TextColor3 = color
		l.Text = line
		l.LayoutOrder = order
		l.Parent = log
	end
	task.defer(function() log.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 1e6) end)
end

local function toggle()
	sg.Enabled = not sg.Enabled
	if sg.Enabled then task.defer(function() box:CaptureFocus() end) end
end
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F2 then toggle()
	elseif box:IsFocused() and #history > 0 then
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up then hIndex = math.max(1, hIndex - 1); box.Text = history[hIndex]
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down then hIndex = math.min(#history + 1, hIndex + 1); box.Text = history[hIndex] or "" end
	end
end)
toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(toggle)

box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
	if not enter then return end
	local text = box.Text
	if text:gsub("%s", "") == "" then return end
	if text:sub(1, 1) ~= ";" then text = ";" .. text end
	table.insert(history, text)
	hIndex = #history + 1
	add("> " .. text, Color3.fromRGB(170, 180, 200))
	cmdEvent:FireServer(text)
	box.Text = ""
	task.defer(function() box:CaptureFocus() end)
end)

cmdEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(msg, ok)
	add(msg, ok and Color3.fromRGB(120, 235, 140) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120))
end)

U.Base = {SizeMult = 1, SpinMult = 1, WalkSpeed = 16, ShovelSlots = 2, PetSlots = 3, PowerBonus = 0, EggDiscount = 0, LuckMult = 1, FriendBoost = 0, RollAnimScale = 1, ReachMult = 1, DoubleRollChance = 0, SnowMult = 1, PowerMult = 1, PetBoostMult = 1, GoldenEvery = 0, RainbowEvery = 0, GoldenLuck = 3, RainbowLuck = 10}
U.Limits = {EggDiscount = {0, 0.5}, DoubleRollChance = {0, 0.5}, RollAnimScale = {0.6, 1}, ReachMult = {1, 1.5}, SpinMult = {1, 1.6}, WalkSpeed = {16, 40}, PetBoostMult = {1, 2}, FriendBoost = {0, 0.2}, GoldenEvery = {0, 10}, RainbowEvery = {0, 100}}
-- lookups
U.ById, U.TreeById = {}, {}
for _, tree in ipairs(U.Trees) do
	U.TreeById[tree.Id] = tree
	tree.ByPos = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(tree.Nodes) do
		n.Tree = tree.Id
		U.ById[n.Id] = n
		tree.ByPos[n.Q .. "," .. n.R] = n
	end
end

local DIRS = {{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}, {1, -1}, {-1, 1}}
function U.Neighbours(n)
	local tree = U.TreeById[n.Tree]
	local out = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(DIRS) do
		local nb = tree.ByPos[(n.Q + d[1]) .. "," .. (n.R + d[2])]
		if nb then table.insert(out, nb) end
	end
	return out
end
function U.Distance(n) return math.max(math.abs(n.Q), math.abs(n.R), math.abs(n.Q + n.R)) end
function U.CostOf(n)
	if n.Cost then return n.Cost end
	local tree = U.TreeById[n.Tree]
	return math.floor(tree.BaseCost * tree.Growth ^ U.Distance(n) * (n.CostMult or 1) + 0.5)
end
-- 2026-10-02 (Claude): Cost-0 stages (World 2 Sakura) open together with the stage before them, exactly like StageService.isOpen.
local StageConfig = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("StageConfig"))
local function openViaPrevious(stage, stages)
	local s = StageConfig.ById[stage]
	while s and s.Cost == 0 do
		local prev = StageConfig.Previous(s.Id)
		if not prev then return false end
		if stages and stages[prev.Id] then return true end
		s = prev
	end
	return false
end
-- A client and the server use the same stage and adjacency rules.
function U.LockReason(n, owned, stages)
 if owned[n.Id] then return "Owned" end
 local stage = n.RequiredStage or "Starter"
 if stage ~= "Starter" and not (stages and stages[stage]) and not openViaPrevious(stage, stages) then
  return "Unlock " .. (({Cursed = "Cursed Biome", Crystal = "Crystal Caves", Retro = "Retro World", AbsoluteZero = "Absolute Zero", Portal = "Absolute Zero Portal"})[stage] or (StageConfig.ById[stage] and StageConfig.ById[stage].Name) or stage) .. " first"
 end
 if n.Center then return nil end
 for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do if owned[nb.Id] then return nil end end
 return "Buy a connected tile first"
end
function U.Available(n, owned, stages) return U.LockReason(n, owned, stages) == nil end
function U.Calculate(owned, friends)
 local stats, mults = table.clone(U.Base), {}
 for id, has in pairs(owned) do
  local n = has and U.ById[id]
  if n and n.Effect then
   local e = n.Effect
   if e[3] == "Mul" then mults[e[1]] = (mults[e[1]] or 1) * (1 + e[2])
   else stats[e[1]] = (stats[e[1]] or 0) + e[2] end
  end
 end
 for k, m in pairs(mults) do stats[k] *= m end
 for k, lim in pairs(U.Limits) do stats[k] = math.clamp(stats[k], lim[1], lim[2]) end
 local friendMult = 1 + stats.FriendBoost * math.clamp(friends or 0, 0, 3)
 stats.SnowMult *= friendMult
 stats.LuckMult *= friendMult
 return stats
end
-- 2026-10-03 (Claude, pacing): early upgrades were all open from the start and cost only ~1-3% of the next stage, so players
-- owned ~70 of the 138 upgrades by Cursed. Now only the inner rings are open at the start; the outer rings of the Snow and Rolls
-- trees unlock with later World 1 stages, and each World 1 stage's upgrades together cost about StageBudgetShare of the next
-- stage's price (prices are only ever raised, never lowered). Owned upgrades are not affected.
U.RingStage = {
	Snow  = {[2] = "Desert", [3] = "Cursed", [4] = "Crystal", [5] = "Retro", [6] = "Jungle"},
	Rolls = {[2] = "Desert", [3] = "Cursed", [4] = "Crystal", [5] = "Crystal", [6] = "Retro", [7] = "Retro", [8] = "Jungle", [9] = "Jungle", [10] = "AbsoluteZero"},
}
U.StageBudgetShare = 0.5
do
	local function nice(x) -- 2 significant digits
		if x < 100 then return math.floor(x + 0.5) end
		local e = 10 ^ (math.floor(math.log10(x)) - 1)
		return math.floor(x / e + 0.5) * e
	end
	for _, n in pairs(U.ById) do
		local map = U.RingStage[n.Tree]
		local st = map and not n.RequiredStage and map[U.Distance(n)]
		if st then n.RequiredStage = st end
	end
	local order = StageConfig.Order
	for i, s in ipairs(order) do
		local nxt = order[i + 1]
		if (s.World or 1) == 1 and nxt and (nxt.World or 1) == 1 and (nxt.Cost or 0) > 0 then
			local batch, sum = {}, 0
			for _, n in pairs(U.ById) do
				if (n.RequiredStage or "Starter") == s.Id then table.insert(batch, n); sum += U.CostOf(n) end
			end
			local scale = sum > 0 and U.StageBudgetShare * nxt.Cost / sum or 1
			if scale > 1 then
				for _, n in ipairs(batch) do n.Cost = nice(U.CostOf(n) * scale) end
			end
		end
	end
end

return U

local buttons = {}
local function setup(btn, hoverScale)
	local st = {
		btn = btn,
		scale = btn:WaitForChild("UIScale"),
		aura = btn:WaitForChild("Aura"),
		sparks = btn:WaitForChild("Sparks"),
		hover = value(1),   -- 1 -> hoverScale
		press = value(1),   -- 1 -> 0.92
		glow = value(0),    -- 0 idle, 1 hovered
		hovering = false,
	}
	st.auraScale = st.aura:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		st.hovering = true
		tween(st.hover, 0.18, {Value = hoverScale}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		tween(st.glow, 0.2, {Value = 1})
	end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		st.hovering = false
		tween(st.hover, 0.2, {Value = 1})
		tween(st.glow, 0.25, {Value = 0})
		tween(st.press, 0.2, {Value = 1})
	end)
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		tween(st.press, 0.07, {Value = 0.92})
	end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		tween(st.press, 0.35, {Value = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end)
	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		-- touch screens may skip Up; make sure it always bounces back
		task.delay(0.08, function() tween(st.press, 0.35, {Value = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
	end)
	buttons[btn] = st
	return st
end

local function updateAura(st, t, phase, extra)
	local pulse = (math.sin(t * 2.2 + phase) + 1) / 2 -- 0..1
	local g = st.glow.Value
	st.auraScale.Scale = 1 + pulse * 0.04 + g * 0.08 + (extra or 0)
	for _, ring in ipairs(st.aura:GetChildren()) do
		if ring:IsA("Frame") then
			local base = ring:GetAttribute("BaseT") or 0.85
			ring.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(base - pulse * 0.05 - g * 0.12, 0, 1)
		end
	end
end

local t = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt

	-- dice
	local float = math.sin(t * 1.6) * 4                 -- a few pixels up/down
	local tilt = math.sin(t * 1.1) * 4                  -- gentle left/right tilt
	local depth = 1 + math.sin(t * 1.1 + math.pi / 2) * 0.03 -- fake 3D: slight horizontal squash as it tilts
	dice.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, float)
	dice.Rotation = tilt + flourishRot.Value
	dice.Size = UDim2.fromScale(depth * flourishScale.Value, flourishScale.Value)
	R.scale.Scale = R.hover.Value * R.press.Value
	updateAura(R, t, 0, math.max(0, -float) * 0.004)

	-- auto
	local on = auto:GetAttribute("On") == true
	if on then
		autoSpin = (autoSpin + dt * 120) % 360
		autoIcon.Rotation = autoSpin
		A.scale.Scale = A.hover.Value * A.press.Value
	else
		if autoSpin ~= 0 then
			-- settle forward to the nearest upright position instead of spinning back
			local target = autoSpin > 0 and 360 or 0
			autoSpin = 0
			tween(autoIcon, 0.4, {Rotation = target}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Connect(function()
				if auto:GetAttribute("On") ~= true then autoIcon.Rotation = 0 end
			end)
		end
		local breath = 1 + (math.sin(t * 2.5) + 1) / 2 * 0.04 -- 100% -> 104% -> 100%
		A.scale.Scale = breath * A.hover.Value * A.press.Value
	end
	updateAura(A, t, 1.3, on and 0.05 or 0)

	-- hide
	H.scale.Scale = H.hover.Value * H.press.Value
	updateAura(H, t, 2.6)
	UP.scale.Scale = UP.hover.Value * UP.press.Value
	updateAura(UP, t, 3.9)
end)

	p.frame.Visible = true
	local left = every - (rollsDone() % every)
	p.nextUp = left == 1
	p.label.Text = p.nextUp and (word .. " NEXT! x" .. mult) or (word .. " IN " .. left)

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
local function round(o, r) return mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(r or 0.2, 0)}, o) end
local function outline(o, th, color, mode)
	return mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = th or 2, Color = color or DARK, ApplyStrokeMode = mode or Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o)
end
local function text(parent, str, props, max, dark)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, Text = str, TextColor3 = dark and TEXT_DARK or WHITE,
		TextScaled = true, TextWrapped = true, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do l[k] = v end
	if not dark then outline(l, 2, DARK, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual) end
	mk("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = max or 32}, l)
	return l
end
local function tween(o, t, goal, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), goal)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function clock(s)
	s = math.max(0, math.floor(s))
	local h, m = math.floor(s / 3600), math.floor(s % 3600 / 60)
	if h > 0 then return string.format("%dh %02dm", h, m) end
	return string.format("%d:%02d", m, s % 60)
end

local queue, showing = {}, false
local function showToast(msg, color)
	if #queue >= 4 then return end
	table.insert(queue, {msg, color or GOLD})
	if showing then return end
	showing = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while #queue > 0 do
			local m = table.remove(queue, 1)
			toast.Text, toast.TextColor3 = m[1], m[2]
			tween(toast, 0.2, {TextTransparency = 0})
			tween(toastStroke, 0.2, {Transparency = 0})
			task.wait(2.6)
			tween(toast, 0.35, {TextTransparency = 1})
			tween(toastStroke, 0.35, {Transparency = 1})
			task.wait(0.4)
		end
		showing = false
	end)
end

-- 2026-10-03 (Claude, alignment pass): widths are shares of the tab row (they add up to 1 with the three 0.015 gaps), so the row
-- ends exactly at the card edges and "ACHIEVEMENTS" has room to use the same text size as the other tabs.
local TAB_WIDTH = {Daily = 0.2, Quests = 0.215, Achievements = 0.335, Codes = 0.205}
local current = "Daily"
local tabButtons, tabColors = {}, {}
for i, t in ipairs(TABS) do
	local b = nodecor(mk("TextButton", {Name = t.Id, LayoutOrder = i, Size = UDim2.fromScale(TAB_WIDTH[t.Id] or 0.235, 1), BackgroundColor3 = t.Color, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = true}, tabBar))
	round(b, 0.3)
	outline(b, 2.5, DARK)
	mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, Color3.fromRGB(205, 215, 235))}, b) -- soft top-lit look
	mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, b)
	local icons = {Daily = SnowUI.Assets.rewards, Quests = SnowUI.Assets.quests, Achievements = SnowUI.Assets.achievement, Codes = SnowUI.Assets.codes}
	local ic = SnowUI.Icon(b, icons[t.Id], UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.76), "CategoryIcon")
	ic.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	local lbl = text(b, string.upper(t.Id), {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.27, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.68, 0.72)}, 24)
	-- icon inset from the left edge and vertically centred, label fills the rest. Uses the tab's width/height ratio (UIScale
	-- does not change it), so the same look works for every tab width and screen size.
	local function layoutTab()
		local s = b.AbsoluteSize
		if s.X <= 0 or s.Y <= 0 then return end
		local a = s.X / s.Y
		local inset, iconH = 0.12, 0.76
		ic.Position = UDim2.fromScale(inset / a, 0.5)
		ic.Size = UDim2.fromScale(iconH / a, iconH)
		local x = (inset + iconH + 0.06) / a
		lbl.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, 0.14)
		lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 - x - inset / a, 0.72)
	end
	b:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(layoutTab)
	layoutTab()
	b.Activated:Connect(function() current = t.Id; render() end)
	tabButtons[t.Id] = b
	tabColors[t.Id] = t.Color
end

local TAB_ICON = {Daily = SnowUI.Assets.rewards, Quests = SnowUI.Assets.quests, Achievements = SnowUI.Assets.achievement, Codes = SnowUI.Assets.codes}
local function header(order, title, sub, _, reserve)

	round(h, 0.3)
	outline(h, 3, DARK)
	mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.2), col:Lerp(DARK, 0.12))}, h)

local function claim(action, arg)

-- 2026-10-03 (Claude, redo): Daily = a 3 x 2 calendar of days 1-6 plus a tall Day 7 prize card, no scrolling. Each day card has a
-- coloured ribbon (green = claimed, gold = next, blue = later), its reward picture and a short title + duration.
local CELL_W, CELL_H, COL_GAP, ROW_GAP, GRID_W = 0.231, 0.475, 0.016, 0.05, 0.725
local REWARD_ICON = {Snow2 = SnowUI.Assets.snow, Luck2 = SnowUI.Assets.luck, Super = SnowUI.Assets.rewards}
local ICON_SCALE = {Luck2 = 1.5, Super = 1.1} -- the clover/gift pictures have more empty margin than the snowflake
local RIBBON_DONE, RIBBON_NEXT, RIBBON_LATER, RIBBON_PRIZE = Color3.fromRGB(70, 195, 105), Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 40), Color3.fromRGB(85, 145, 235), Color3.fromRGB(240, 95, 125)
local SLATE = Color3.fromRGB(90, 108, 145)
local function rewardLines(i, txt)
	local def = A.Daily[i] or {}
	local boost = def.Boost and A.Boosts[def.Boost]
	if boost then return boost.Name, math.floor((def.Seconds or 0) / 60 + 0.5) .. " min", def.Boost, boost end
	return (string.gsub(txt or "", "^[^%w]+", "")), nil, nil, nil -- server text without its leading emoji
end
local function dayCard(body, name, pos, size, claimed, isNext, top, bottom)
	local f = nodecor(mk("Frame", {Name = name, Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = WHITE}, body))
	round(f, 0.13)
	outline(f, isNext and 4 or 3, isNext and Color3.fromRGB(240, 130, 20) or DARK)
	mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = claimed and ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(228, 250, 233), Color3.fromRGB(188, 236, 200))
		or ColorSequence.new(top, bottom)}, f)
	return f
end
local function ribbon(card, label, color, y, h)
	local r = nodecor(mk("Frame", {Name = "Ribbon", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, y), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, h),
		BackgroundColor3 = color}, card))
	round(r, 0.5)
	outline(r, 2, DARK)
	text(r, label, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.08), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.84)}, 24)
	return r
end
local function picture(card, id, k, pos, size)
	local slot = mk("Frame", {Name = "RewardIcon", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = pos, Size = size}, card)
	mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {AspectRatio = 1}, slot)
	local img = SnowUI.Icon(slot, id, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(k or 1, k or 1), "Picture")
	img.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	return slot
end
local function dayTile(body, i, txt, dd)
	local claimed, isNext = i <= dd.Through, i == dd.NextDay
	local col, row = (i - 1) % 3, math.floor((i - 1) / 3)
	local card = dayCard(body, "Day" .. i, UDim2.fromScale(col * (CELL_W + COL_GAP), row * (CELL_H + ROW_GAP)), UDim2.fromScale(CELL_W, CELL_H),
		claimed, isNext, WHITE, Color3.fromRGB(222, 236, 255))
	ribbon(card, "DAY " .. i, claimed and RIBBON_DONE or (isNext and RIBBON_NEXT or RIBBON_LATER), 0.07, 0.25)
	if claimed then text(card, "\u{2705}", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, -0.1), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.34), ZIndex = 4}, 30) end
	local main, sub, kind = rewardLines(i, txt)
	picture(card, (kind and REWARD_ICON[kind]) or SnowUI.Assets.snow, ICON_SCALE[kind], UDim2.fromScale(0.22, 0.65), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5))
	if sub then
		text(card, main, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.37), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.56, 0.3), TextColor3 = DARK}, 26, true)
		text(card, sub, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.66), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.56, 0.22), TextColor3 = SLATE}, 20, true)
	else
		text(card, main, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.4, 0.45), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.56, 0.34), TextColor3 = DARK}, 26, true)
	end
end
local function prizeTile(body, i, txt, dd)
	local claimed, isNext = i <= dd.Through, i == dd.NextDay
	local x = GRID_W + COL_GAP
	local card = dayCard(body, "Day" .. i, UDim2.fromScale(x, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1 - x, 1), claimed, isNext,
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 247, 212), Color3.fromRGB(255, 206, 108))
	ribbon(card, "DAY " .. i, claimed and RIBBON_DONE or (isNext and RIBBON_NEXT or RIBBON_PRIZE), 0.04, 0.115)
	if claimed then text(card, "\u{2705}", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.74, -0.05), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.32, 0.17), ZIndex = 4}, 34) end
	local main, sub, kind, boost = rewardLines(i, txt)

	text(card, string.upper(main), {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.13)}, 32)
	if boost and (boost.Snow or 1) > 1 and (boost.Luck or 1) > 1 then
		text(card, string.format("%dx Snow + %dx Luck", boost.Snow, boost.Luck), {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.74), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.1), TextColor3 = DARK}, 22, true)
	end
	if sub then text(card, "for " .. sub, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.845), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.09), TextColor3 = SLATE}, 20, true) end
end

-- 1.35x / 12.4x / 777x / 1.3Kx / 25Mx
local function fmt(v)
	local t
	if v >= 1000 then t = NumberFormat.Abbreviate(v)
	elseif v >= 100 then t = tostring(math.floor(v))
	elseif v >= 10 then t = (string.format("%.1f", math.floor(v * 10) / 10):gsub("%.0$", ""))
	else t = (string.format("%.2f", math.floor(v * 100) / 100):gsub("%.?0+$", "")) end
	return t .. "x"
end

local function pop(f)
	local s = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	s.Scale = 1.2
	TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Scale = 1}):Play()
end

local showing = nil
local lastLuck, lastDmg
local function update()
	local total = player:GetAttribute("TotalLuck") or 1
	local power = player:GetAttribute("PowerMult") or 1
	luck.Value.Text = fmt(total)
	dmg.Value.Text = fmt(power)
	if lastLuck and total > lastLuck then pop(luck) end
	if lastDmg and power > lastDmg then pop(dmg) end
	lastLuck, lastDmg = total, power
	if showing == "Luck" then
		local friends = player:GetAttribute("FriendsHere") or 0
		local base = player:GetAttribute("LuckBase") or 1
		local rebirth = player:GetAttribute("RebirthLuckMult") or 1
		local friendMult = 1 + (player:GetAttribute("FriendBoost") or 0) * math.clamp(friends, 0, 3)
		local upgradePct = math.max(0, (player:GetAttribute("LuckMult") or 1) / (rebirth * friendMult) - 1)
		local lines = {'<font color="#8CFF96">LUCK ' .. fmt(total) .. '</font>', "Upgrades +" .. math.floor(upgradePct * 100 + 0.5) .. "%"}
		if rebirth > 1 then table.insert(lines, "Rebirths " .. fmt(rebirth)) end
		if friendMult > 1 then table.insert(lines, "Friends +" .. math.floor((friendMult - 1) * 100 + 0.5) .. "%") end
		if base ~= 1 then table.insert(lines, "Bonus " .. fmt(base)) end
		boxText.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	elseif showing == "Damage" then
		boxText.Text = '<font color="#FF8C8C">DAMAGE ' .. fmt(power) .. '</font>\nFrom upgrade tiles.\nBetter shovels hit\nharder too!'
	end
end
for _, a in ipairs({"TotalLuck", "LuckMult", "LuckBase", "FriendsHere", "FriendBoost", "RebirthLuckMult", "PowerMult"}) do
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(a):Connect(update)
end

local function hook(f)
	local hit = f:WaitForChild("Hit")
	hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function() showing = f.Name; box.Visible = true; update() end)
	hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if showing == f.Name then showing = nil; box.Visible = false end end)
	hit.Activated:Connect(function()
		if showing == f.Name and box.Visible then showing = nil; box.Visible = false
		else showing = f.Name; box.Visible = true; update() end
	end)
end
hook(luck)
hook(dmg)
update()

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
-- everything here skips SnowUI's automatic frost overlay (same clean style as the other menus)
local function frame(parent, props)
	local f = mk("Frame", {BorderSizePixel = 0}, nil)
	f:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do f[k] = v end
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end
local function round(o, r) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(r or 0.5, 0)}, o) return o end
local function outline(o, t, c) return mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = t, Color = c or NAVY, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o) end
local function grad(o, a, b) return mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(a, b)}, o) end
local function text(parent, str, props, max, st)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = FONT, Text = str, TextScaled = true, TextWrapped = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do l[k] = v end
	if st ~= false then mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = st or 2, Color = NAVY}, l) end
	mk("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = max or 30}, l)
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

local function petIcon(parent, name, pos, size)
	local vp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1), Position = pos, Size = size}, nil)
	vp:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {AspectRatio = 1}, vp)
	vp.Parent = parent
	local ok, model = pcall(PetModels.create, name)
	if ok and model then
		model.Parent = vp
		local cf, sz = model:GetBoundingBox()
		local look = model:GetPivot().LookVector
		local dist = math.max(sz.X, sz.Y, sz.Z) * 2 + 0.5
		local cam = mk("Camera", {FieldOfView = 35}, vp)
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + look * dist + Vector3.new(0, dist * 0.25, 0), cf.Position)

	end
	return vp

local function call(...)
	local args = table.pack(...)
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n)) end)
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then return res end
	return {Ok = false, Msg = "Try again in a moment"}
end

local function makePage(name, title, hint, emoji, color, scroll)
	local panel = panels:WaitForChild(name)

	local hintL = text(head, hint, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.11, 0.58), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.87, 0.32), TextXAlignment = LEFT}, 20)
	local area

			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, ScrollBarThickness = 7, ScrollBarImageColor3 = WHITE}, root)
		mk("UIPadding", {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)}, area)

	local f = frame(list, {Name = "Empty", BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})

local function sortReady(list)
	for i, e in ipairs(list) do e.Order = i end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		local ra, rb = a.Spare >= a.Need, b.Spare >= b.Need
		if ra ~= rb then return ra end
		return a.Order < b.Order
	end)
end

		-- 2026-10-03 (Claude): models with MachineRotate (deg/s) turn around their pivot's X axis (the Shovel Forge gear)
		if p:IsA("Model") and p:GetAttribute("MachineRotate") then
			table.insert(spinners, {model = p, base = p:GetPivot(), speed = math.rad(p:GetAttribute("MachineRotate")), machine = topMachine(p)})
		end
	end
	local t = 0
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		t += dt
		for _, s in ipairs(spinners) do if not (s.machine and s.machine:GetAttribute("LocalLocked")) then s.model:PivotTo(s.base * CFrame.Angles(t * s.speed, 0, 0)) end end
		for _, m in ipairs(movers) do
			if m.machine and m.machine:GetAttribute("LocalLocked") then continue end
			if m.part:GetAttribute("MachineBob") then
				m.part.CFrame = m.base * CFrame.new(0, math.sin(t * 2 + m.phase) * 0.25, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * (m.part:GetAttribute("MachineSpin") or 0), 0)
			else
				m.part.Transparency = 0.1 + 0.15 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 9 + m.phase))
			end
		end
	end)
end)

local function lighten(c, a) return c:Lerp(WHITE, a) end

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function round(p, s) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(s, 0)}, p) end
local function label(parent, t, props, st)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = t}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end

		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)

	local main = mk("Frame", {Name = "Main", BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)

	main:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	round(main, 0.16)
	mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(lighten(color, 0.55), color), Rotation = 90}, main)

		ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = iconBox

	if item.Mutation and not locked and mode == "inventory" then -- Index tabs already say which version
		local rib = mk("Frame", {Name = "MutationRibbon", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.44),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = 4}, holder) -- 2026-10-03 (Claude): between picture and name, no longer piled on the X / count badge

			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.66, Color3.fromRGB(110, 225, 130)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(110, 150, 255))})
			or item.Mutation == "Shiny" and ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 130), Color3.fromRGB(238, 160, 25))

			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.18)}, canAdd and Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90),

				Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.26)}, Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 80), "X")

		label(badge, "x" .. count, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, 0.76), TextColor3 = OUTLINE}, false)
	end

	main.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(scale, 0.15, {Scale = 1.04}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
	main.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(scale, 0.15, {Scale = 1}) end)
	holder.Parent = parent
end

local INDEX_CATS = {
	{Id = "Normal", Title = "INDEX", Tab = "NormalTab", Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255)},
	{Id = "Giant", Title = "GIANT", Tab = "GiantTab", Slot = 1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 190, 255)},
	{Id = "Shiny", Title = "SHINY", Tab = "ShinyTab", Slot = 2, Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 180, 40)},
	{Id = "Shiny Giant", Title = "SHINY GIANT", Tab = "ShinyGiantTab", Slot = 3, Color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 110, 255)},
}
local indexCat = INDEX_CATS[1]
local indexTabs = panels.Index.Inner:FindFirstChild("TabBar")
-- 2026-10-03 (Claude, alignment pass): every tab keeps its own colour (the authored UIGradient makes SnowUI use the frost-border
-- art instead of the opaque cyan button art, which made all four tabs look identical); the open tab is full colour, white-outlined
-- and slightly taller, the others are a darker shade of their colour.
local function styleIndexTabs()
	if not indexTabs then return end
	for _, c in ipairs(INDEX_CATS) do
		local b = indexTabs:FindFirstChild(c.Tab)
		if b then
			local sel = c == indexCat
			b.BackgroundColor3 = sel and c.Color or c.Color:Lerp(OUTLINE, 0.2) -- closed tabs: darker shade, white text stays readable
			local st = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
			if st then st.Color = sel and WHITE or OUTLINE; st.Thickness = sel and 3.5 or 2.5 end
			-- taller instead of scaled, so the open tab stays exactly over its card column
			b.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2275, sel and 1.12 or 1) -- 4 tabs + 3 gaps of 0.03 = the full grid width
		end
	end
end
if indexTabs then
	for _, c in ipairs(INDEX_CATS) do
		local b = indexTabs:FindFirstChild(c.Tab)
		if b then
			b.Activated:Connect(function()
				if indexCat == c then return end
				indexCat = c
				styleIndexTabs()
				panels.Index.Inner.Content.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
				refresh()
			end)
		end
	end
	styleIndexTabs()
	-- 2026-10-03 (Claude): one text size for the four tab names (the longest, SHINY GIANT, decides). Boxes are measured without
	-- UIScale (panel pop-in, selected tab), so the size stays stable while the panel animates.
	local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
	local names, lastKey = {}, nil
	for _, c in ipairs(INDEX_CATS) do
		local b = indexTabs:FindFirstChild(c.Tab)
		local l = b and b:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
		if l then table.insert(names, l) end
	end
	local function unscaledSize(o)
		local s, p = 1, o
		while p and p ~= gui do
			local u = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
			if u then s *= u.Scale end
			p = p.Parent
		end
		return o.AbsoluteSize / math.max(s, 0.01)
	end
	local function fitNames()
		local boxes, key = {}, {}
		for i, l in ipairs(names) do
			local box = unscaledSize(l)
			if box.X < 8 or box.Y < 8 then return end -- not laid out yet
			boxes[i] = box
			key[i] = math.floor(box.X / 4) .. "x" .. math.floor(box.Y / 4)
		end
		local k = table.concat(key, ",")
		if #names == 0 or k == lastKey then return end
		lastKey = k
		local best = 40
		for i, l in ipairs(names) do
			local lo, hi = 6, best
			while lo < hi do
				local mid = math.ceil((lo + hi) / 2)
				local ok, sz = pcall(TextService.GetTextSize, TextService, l.Text, mid, l.Font, Vector2.new(10000, 10000))
				if not ok then return end
				if sz.X <= boxes[i].X - 4 and sz.Y <= boxes[i].Y then lo = mid else hi = mid - 1 end
			end
			best = lo
		end
		for _, l in ipairs(names) do l.TextScaled = false; l.TextSize = best end
	end
	for _, l in ipairs(names) do l:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fitNames) end
	task.defer(fitNames)
end

refresh = function()
	local idx = panels.Index.Inner.Content
	local inv = panels.Inventory.Inner.Content
	clear(idx); clear(inv)
	local owned, invCards, catOwned = 0, 0, 0
	for i, item in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		local n = counts[item.Name] or 0
		if n > 0 then
			owned += 1
			invCards += 1
			card(inv, i * 10, item, n, false, "inventory")
		end
		-- the Index shows this shovel in the selected version (Normal / Giant / Shiny / Shiny Giant)
		local shown = item
		if indexCat.Slot and Config.VariantsOf and Config.VariantsOf[item.Name] then shown = Config.VariantsOf[item.Name][indexCat.Slot] or item end
		local sn = counts[shown.Name] or 0
		if sn > 0 then catOwned += 1 end
		card(idx, i * 10, shown, sn, sn == 0, "index")
		-- mutated versions you own (Giant / Shiny / Shiny Giant) sit right after their shovel in the Inventory
		for k, v in ipairs(Config.VariantsOf and Config.VariantsOf[item.Name] or {}) do
			local vn = counts[v.Name] or 0
			if vn > 0 then
				invCards += 1
				card(inv, i * 10 + k, v, vn, false, "inventory")
			end
		end
	end
	-- 2026-10-03 (Claude, redo): the empty message sits over the area instead of being squeezed into one grid cell
	local note = panels.Inventory.Inner:FindFirstChild("ShovelEmptyNote")
	if not note then
		note = label(panels.Inventory.Inner, "Roll the dice to find your first shovel!", {Name = "ShovelEmptyNote", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.55), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.12), ZIndex = 3}, 3)
		inv:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() note.Visible = note:GetAttribute("Empty") == true and inv.Visible end)
	end
	note:SetAttribute("Empty", invCards == 0)
	note.Visible = invCards == 0 and inv.Visible
	panels.Index.Banner.Title.Text = ("%s %d/%d"):format(indexCat.Title, catOwned, #Config.Items)
	if panels.Inventory:GetAttribute("Tab") ~= "Pets" then panels.Inventory.Banner.Title.Text = ("INVENTORY %d/%d"):format(#equipped, game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("ShovelSlots") or MAX_EQUIPPED) end
end

local function tween(o, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function round(p, s) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(s, 0)}, p) end
local function label(parent, t, props, st)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = t}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	if st ~= false then mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = st or 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, l) end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

-- 3D pet preview inside a frame
local function viewport(parent, petName, props)
	local vp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210),
		LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do vp[k] = v end
	local m = PetModels.create(petName)
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	m.Parent = vp
	local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
	local dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 1.7 + 1.5
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 40
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(dist * 0.45, dist * 0.25, -dist), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	vp.Parent = parent
	return vp, m
end

local function copies(name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(equipped) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

local busy = false
local function send(action, name)
	if busy then return end
	busy = true
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return equipRemote:InvokeServer(action, name) end)
	busy = false
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then equipped = res; refresh() end
end

local function card(order, pet, count)
	local color = PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
	local holder = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order}, nil)
	local shadow = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.78, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(shadow, 0.16)
	local main = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	main:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true) -- 2026-10-03 (Claude): clean card outline, no frost overlay
	round(main, 0.16)
	mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55), color), Rotation = 90}, main)
	local stroke = mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 4, Color = color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.45), ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, main)
	viewport(main, pet.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.02), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.44)})
	mk("UITextSizeConstraint", {MaxTextSize = 22}, label(main, pet.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.46), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.14)}, 2.5))
	label(main, "+" .. math.floor(pet.Boost * 100 + 0.5) .. "% ❄", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.11),
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 150)}, 2.5)

	local on = copies(pet.Name)
	local canAdd = on < count
	local eb = smallButton(main, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.75), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.17)},
		canAdd and Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90), canAdd and "EQUIP" or "EQUIPPED")
	eb.Activated:Connect(function() if canAdd then send("equip", pet.Name) end end)
	if on > 0 then
		stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 230, 90)
		stroke.Thickness = 4.5
		local x = smallButton(holder, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.07), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.26)},
			Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 80), "X")
		mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {AspectRatio = 1}, x)
		x.Activated:Connect(function() send("unequip", pet.Name) end)
	end
	local badge = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.07), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.38, 0.17)}, holder)
	badge:SetAttribute("SnowUIDecor", true)
	round(badge, 1)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, badge)
	label(badge, "x" .. count, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, 0.76), TextColor3 = OUTLINE}, false)
	holder.Parent = petContent
end

refresh = function()
	for _, c in ipairs(petContent:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local order, any = 0, false
	for _, egg in ipairs(PetConfig.Eggs) do
		for _, pet in ipairs(egg.Pets) do
			order += 1
			local n = pets[pet.Name] or 0
			if n > 0 then any = true; card(order, pet, n) end
		end
	end
	-- 2026-10-03 (Claude, redo): the empty message sits over the area instead of being squeezed into one grid cell
	local note = inner:FindFirstChild("PetEmptyNote")
	if not note then
		note = label(inner, "Open an egg to get your first pet!", {Name = "PetEmptyNote", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.55), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.12), ZIndex = 3}, 3)
		petContent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() note.Visible = note:GetAttribute("Empty") == true and petContent.Visible end)
	end
	note:SetAttribute("Empty", not any)
	note.Visible = (not any) and petContent.Visible
	if tab == "Pets" then
		title.Text = ("PETS %d/%d"):format(#equipped, Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("PetSlots") or MAX)
	end
end

-- New 2026 egg art: clone the Shell mesh from the lobby EggDisplay; old procedural eggs are the fallback.
local function eggArt(eggId)
	local display = workspace:FindFirstChild("EggDisplay", true)
	local src = display and display:FindFirstChild(eggId)
	if not (src and src:FindFirstChild("Shell")) then
		-- World 2 eggs (2026-10-02, Claude) stand in their own stages, not in the lobby EggDisplay
		for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("Model") and d.Name == eggId and d:FindFirstChild("Shell") then src = d; break end
		end
	end
	local shell = src and src:FindFirstChild("Shell")
	if shell and shell:IsA("MeshPart") then
		local m = Instance.new("Model")
		m.Name = eggId
		local c = shell:Clone()
		c.Anchored = true
		c.PivotOffset = CFrame.new() -- imported meshes carry a 90-degree pivot; keep the egg upright
		c.CFrame = CFrame.new()
		c.Parent = m
		m.PrimaryPart = c
		-- World 2 eggs: decoration parts tagged EggArt (petals, bands...) follow the shell
		for _, d in ipairs(src:GetChildren()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") and d:GetAttribute("EggArt") then
				local e = d:Clone()
				e.Anchored = true
				e.CFrame = shell.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(d.CFrame)
				e.Parent = m
			end
		end
		return m
	end
	return EggModels.create(eggId)
end

local playing = false
local function playHatch(eggId, petName, isNew)
	playing = true
	for _, c in ipairs(stage:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("ViewportFrame") then c:Destroy() end end
	topText.Text, nameText.Text, subText.Text = "", "", ""
	overlay.Visible = true
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tween(overlay, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.45})
	tween(blur, 0.25, {Size = 18})

	-- the egg: a clone of the real egg model if possible
	local eggVp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 21,
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, stage)
	local eggModel = eggArt(eggId)
	eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	eggModel.Parent = eggVp
	local _, size = eggModel:GetBoundingBox()
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 40
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, size.Y * 0.15, -math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 2.2), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = eggVp
	eggVp.CurrentCamera = cam
	topText.Text = "Hatching..."

	-- shake harder and harder
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < 1.6 do
		local k = (os.clock() - t0) / 1.6
		eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(os.clock() * (18 + k * 30)) * (0.08 + k * 0.28)))
		task.wait()
	end

	-- pop!
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	tween(flash, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	eggVp:Destroy()
	local pet = PetConfig.PetByName[petName]
	local color = pet and PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
	local vp, model = viewport(stage, petName, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 21})
	local popScale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0.3}, stage)
	tween(popScale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	topText.Text = isNew and "NEW PET!" or "You hatched"
	topText.TextColor3 = isNew and Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 90) or WHITE
	nameText.Text = petName
	nameText.TextColor3 = color
	subText.Text = (pet and pet.Rarity or "") .. "  •  +" .. math.floor((pet and pet.Boost or 0) * 100 + 0.5) .. "% ❄"
	subText.TextColor3 = WHITE

	local t1 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t1 < 2.4 do
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, (os.clock() - t1) * 1.5, 0))
		task.wait()
	end
	tween(overlay, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(blur, 0.3, {Size = 0})
	task.wait(0.3)
	popScale:Destroy()
	vp:Destroy()
	overlay.Visible = false
	topText.Text, nameText.Text, subText.Text = "", "", ""
	playing = false
end

local signs = {} -- [eggId] = {slots = {[petName] = {vp, scale}}}

-- black silhouette until discovered; `justFound` lights up with a pop
updateSigns = function(justFound)
	for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
		for name, slot in pairs(entry.slots) do
			local known = discovered[name] == true
			if known and name == justFound then
				slot.vp.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				tween(slot.vp, 0.6, {ImageColor3 = WHITE})
				slot.scale.Scale = 1.35
				tween(slot.scale, 0.5, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			else
				slot.vp.ImageColor3 = known and WHITE or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function makeSign(prompt)
	local part = prompt.Parent
	if not part then return end
	local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	while model and not PetConfig.EggById[model.Name] do model = model:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") end
	if not model then return end
	local egg = PetConfig.EggById[model.Name]
	local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	if pg:FindFirstChild("PetSign_" .. egg.Id) then return end
	local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()

	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Name = "PetSign_" .. egg.Id
	bb.Adornee = part
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(270, 205)
	bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2 + 4.8, 0)
	-- lobby row eggs (Shell on a pedestal): sit the panel just above the egg itself
	local shellPart = model:FindFirstChild("Shell")
	if shellPart and shellPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		local eggTop = shellPart.Position.Y + shellPart.Size.Y / 2 - part.Position.Y
		bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, eggTop + 1.3, 0)
		bb.SizeOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	end
	bb.MaxDistance = 1000
	bb.Enabled = false -- shown by the proximity loop below
	bb.LightInfluence = 0
	bb.ResetOnSpawn = false

	local frame = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 30, 55), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, bb)
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)}, frame)
	-- Transparent outer panel; preserve pet tiles, text, odds and layout.
	label(frame, egg.Name:upper() .. "  •  " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(egg.Cost) .. " ❄", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 26)}, 2)

	local grid = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 38), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -44)}, frame)
	mk("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 78), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6),
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, grid)

	local entry = {slots = {}, bb = bb, part = part, shown = false, scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0}, frame)}
	for i, pet in ipairs(egg.Pets) do
		local color = PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
		local cell = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = i}, grid)
		local tile = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = color, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58)}, cell)
		mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)}, tile)
		mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5), color), Rotation = 90}, tile)
		mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, tile)
		local scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, tile)
		local vp = viewport(tile, pet.Name, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})
		label(cell, pet.Chance .. "%", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 58), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)}, 2)
		entry.slots[pet.Name] = {vp = vp, scale = scale}
	end
	signs[egg.Id] = entry
	bb.Parent = pg
	updateSigns()
end

-- egg signs only show when you're close; they pop in and shrink away
local SHOW_DISTANCE = 25
local HIDE_DISTANCE = 30
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		-- eggs stand close together in the lobby row: only the nearest egg's sign may show
		local nearest, nearestDist = nil, math.huge
		for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
			if entry.bb and entry.part and entry.part.Parent and hrp then
				local d = (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude
				if d < nearestDist then nearest, nearestDist = entry, d end
			end
		end
		for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
			if entry.bb and entry.part and entry.part.Parent then
				local dist = hrp and (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
				if entry ~= nearest then dist = math.huge end
				if not entry.shown and dist < SHOW_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = true
					entry.bb.Enabled = true
					entry.scale.Scale = 0
					tween(entry.scale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				elseif entry.shown and dist > HIDE_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = false
					local tw = tween(entry.scale, 0.2, {Scale = 0}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					tw.Completed:Connect(function()
						if not entry.shown then entry.bb.Enabled = false end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.15)
	end
end)

local ORDER = Config.RarityOrder
local TIER = {}
for i, n in ipairs(ORDER) do TIER[n] = i end

local function tierForChance(c)
	local best = 1
	for i, n in ipairs(ORDER) do
		if c >= (Config.RarityMinChance[n] or 0) then best = i end
	end
	return best
end

function Cutscene.ShouldPlay(item, luck)
	return item ~= nil and item.Chance / math.max(luck or 1, 1) >= Config.RareDrop.Threshold
end

local function tween(o, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end

local function show3D(item)
	local t = templates and (templates:FindFirstChild(item.Base or item.Name) or templates:FindFirstChild(item.Name))
	if not t then ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = iconHolder return nil end
	local vp = mk("ViewportFrame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 190), LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -2)}, iconHolder)
	local m = t:Clone()
	for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("Highlight") then d:Destroy() end end
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	m.Parent = vp
	local cf, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
	local cam = mk("Camera", {FieldOfView = 35}, vp)
	local dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 1.7 + 0.5
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, size.Y * 0.1, dist), cf.Position)
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	return m, cf.Position
end

-- cached Sound per id (so we know each file's real length for timing)
local cache = {}
local function soundFor(def)
	if not def or not def.Id or def.Id == "" then return nil end
	local s = cache[def.Id]
	if not s then
		s = Instance.new("Sound")
		s.SoundId = def.Id
		s.Parent = sg
		cache[def.Id] = s
	end
	return s
end
local function lengthOf(def, fallback)
	local s = soundFor(def)
	if s and s.IsLoaded and s.TimeLength > 0 then return s.TimeLength / (def.Speed or 1) end
	return fallback or 0.8
end
local function playDef(def, volMul)
	local s = soundFor(def)
	if not s then return end
	s.PlaybackSpeed = def.Speed or 1
	s.Volume = (def.Volume or 1) * (volMul or 1)
	s.TimePosition = 0
	s:Play()
end
local function play(key, volMul) playDef(Config.RareDrop.Sounds[key], volMul) end
local function stepDef(tierName)
	local steps = Config.RareDrop.Sounds.Steps or {}
	return steps[tierName] or steps.Rare
end

-- preload everything when the player joins
task.spawn(function()
	local S = Config.RareDrop.Sounds
	local list = {}
	for _, key in ipairs({"Start", "Reveal", "End"}) do table.insert(list, soundFor(S[key])) end
	for _, def in pairs(S.Steps or {}) do table.insert(list, soundFor(def)) end
	pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(list) end)
end)

local shakeConn
local function shake(power, duration)
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end
	if shakeConn then shakeConn:Disconnect() end
	local t0 = os.clock()
	shakeConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local k = 1 - (os.clock() - t0) / duration
		if k <= 0 then
			hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
			shakeConn:Disconnect()
			shakeConn = nil
			return
		end
		hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * power * k
	end)
end

local function shockwave(color, size)
	ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.1)
	ringStroke.Color = color
	ringStroke.Transparency = 0
	ringStroke.Thickness = 12
	tween(ring, 0.6, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(size, size)})
	tween(ringStroke, 0.6, {Transparency = 1, Thickness = 2})
end

-- PLAY (yields until finished)
--------------------------------------------------
local playing = false
function Cutscene.IsPlaying() return playing end

function Cutscene.Play(item, luck, isNew)
	if playing or not item then return end
	playing = true
	luck = math.max(luck or 1, 1)
	local S = Config.RareDrop.Sounds
	local itemTier = TIER[item.Rarity] or tierForChance(item.Chance)
	local finalColor = Config.Rarities[ORDER[itemTier]] or WHITE
	local skipped = false
	local skipConn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return then skipped = true end
	end)
	player:SetAttribute("MusicDuck", true)
	sg.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	sg.Enabled = true
	blur.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
	newBadge.Visible = false
	skipHint.TextTransparency = 1; skipStroke.Transparency = 1
	resetFx()

	-- 1) dark screen + start sound
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK
	play("Start")
	tween(bg, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = 0})
	tween(blur, 0.25, {Size = 30})
	shake(0.4, 0.25)
	task.wait(math.min(lengthOf(S.Start, 1.1), 0.55))

	-- 2) THE COUNTER: "1 in N" races up to the real odds; each new rarity it passes = colour change, bass hit, shockwave, lightning
	local target = math.max(item.Chance, 2)
	local logT = math.log10(target)
	local duration = math.clamp(0.8 + logT * 0.27, 1.1, 3.6)
	tierLabel.Text, oddsLabel.Text = "", "1 in 1"
	tierLabel.TextTransparency, tierStroke.Transparency = 0, 0
	oddsLabel.TextTransparency, oddsStroke.Transparency = 0, 0
	oddsLabel.TextColor3 = WHITE
	rune.ImageTransparency, glowSprite.ImageTransparency = 0.35, 0.6
	local t0, prevT, nextTick, lastTier = os.clock(), os.clock(), 0, 0
	while true do
		local now = os.clock()
		local dt = now - prevT
		prevT = now
		local p = math.min((now - t0) / duration, 1)
		if skipped and now - t0 > 0.35 then p = 1 end
		local value = (p >= 1) and target or math.max(1, math.floor(10 ^ ((p ^ 1.3) * logT) + 0.5))
		oddsLabel.Text = "1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(value)
		local ti = tierForChance(value)
		local color = Config.Rarities[ORDER[ti]] or WHITE
		if ti ~= lastTier then
			lastTier = ti
			tierLabel.Text = ORDER[ti]:upper()
			tierLabel.TextColor3 = color
			tierScale.Scale = 1.9
			tween(tierScale, 0.25, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			rune.ImageColor3, glowSprite.ImageColor3 = color, color
			bg.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK:Lerp(color, 0.16 + ti * 0.012)
			if ti > 1 then
				playDef(stepDef(ORDER[ti]), 0.8 + ti * 0.04)
				shockSprite(color)
				lightningFlash(color)
				shockwave(color, 0.7 + ti * 0.15)
				shake(0.25 + ti * 0.12, 0.3)
			end
		end
		if now >= nextTick then
			tickSound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.9 + p * 1.0
			tickSound:Play()
			nextTick = now + (0.11 - 0.08 * p)
			counterScale.Scale = 1.09
			tween(counterScale, 0.07, {Scale = 1})
		end
		rune.Rotation += dt * (35 + 380 * p)
		rune.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.48 + 0.3 * p, 0.48 + 0.3 * p)
		glowSprite.ImageTransparency = math.clamp(0.7 - 0.35 * p + math.sin(now * 22) * 0.05, 0, 1)
		updateStreaks(now, p, color)
		if p >= 1 then break end
		task.wait()
	end
	-- slam on the real number
	oddsLabel.TextColor3 = finalColor:Lerp(WHITE, 0.25)
	counterScale.Scale = 1.7
	tween(counterScale, 0.3, {Scale = 1.15}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	shockSprite(finalColor)
	lightningFlash(finalColor)
	shake(1.0, 0.35)
	hideStreaks()
	task.wait(skipped and 0.25 or 0.55)

	-- 3) white flash + reveal: the real 3D shovel spins inside the rune circle; confetti + stars
	play("Reveal")
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	tierLabel.TextTransparency = 1; tierStroke.Transparency = 1
	oddsLabel.TextTransparency = 1; oddsStroke.Transparency = 1
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = BLACK:Lerp(finalColor, 0.22)
	for _, c in ipairs(iconHolder:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end end
	local model, centre = show3D(item)
	iconHolder.Visible = true
	iconScale.Scale = 0.2
	raysTint.Color = ColorSequence.new(finalColor:Lerp(WHITE, 0.3))
	rays.GroupTransparency = 0.15
	rune.ImageColor3, rune.ImageTransparency = finalColor, 0.45
	tween(rune, 0.5, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.62)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	glowSprite.ImageColor3, glowSprite.ImageTransparency = finalColor, 0.45
	nameLabel.Text = item.Name:upper()
	nameLabel.TextColor3 = WHITE
	subLabel.Text = ORDER[itemTier]:upper() .. "  \u{2022}  1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance)
	subLabel.TextColor3 = finalColor
	if isNew then
		newBadge.Visible = true
		badgeScale.Scale = 0.3
		tween(badgeScale, 0.4, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end
	tween(flash, 0.7, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(iconScale, 0.5, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	for _, o in ipairs({nameLabel, subLabel}) do tween(o, 0.35, {TextTransparency = 0}) end
	for _, o in ipairs({nameStroke, subStroke}) do tween(o, 0.35, {Transparency = 0}) end
	shake(1.4, 0.5)
	shockwave(finalColor, 2)
	shockSprite(finalColor)
	burstConfetti(finalColor, 46)
	starBurst(finalColor, 16)
	task.delay(0.9, function()
		if playing then tween(skipHint, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 0.25}); tween(skipStroke, 0.3, {Transparency = 0.25}) end
	end)
	skipped = false
	local hold = math.max(lengthOf(S.Reveal, 1.5) + 0.2, 1.9 + itemTier * 0.25)
	local h0, hprev, nextStars = os.clock(), os.clock(), os.clock() + 0.6
	while os.clock() - h0 < hold and not (skipped and os.clock() - h0 > 0.8) do
		local now = os.clock()
		local t, dt = now - h0, now - hprev
		hprev = now
		rays.Rotation = t * 25
		rune.Rotation += dt * 30
		iconHolder.Rotation = math.sin(t * 2) * 3
		glowSprite.ImageTransparency = 0.45 + math.sin(t * 3) * 0.08
		if model and centre then model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(centre) * CFrame.Angles(0, t * 1.5, 0) * CFrame.new(-centre)) end
		if now >= nextStars then nextStars = now + 0.5; starBurst(finalColor, 4) end
		task.wait()
	end
	skipConn:Disconnect()

	-- 4) out: fade, then a real 3D burst from the VFX pack around you in the world
	play("End")
	local out = math.max(lengthOf(S.End, 0.9), 0.35)
	for _, o in ipairs({nameLabel, subLabel, skipHint}) do tween(o, out * 0.6, {TextTransparency = 1}) end

local NSLOTS = 7
local slots = {}
local seq = {}

local function label(parent, props, st)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Font = FONT; l.TextScaled = true; l.TextColor3 = WHITE; l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Text = ""
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Thickness = st; s.Color = BLACK; s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round; s.Parent = l
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

for i = 1, NSLOTS do
	local cg = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	cg.Name = "Slot" .. i
	cg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	cg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	cg.Visible = false
	local sc = Instance.new("UIScale"); sc.Parent = cg
	local odds = label(cg, {Name = "Odds", Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.03), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.2), TextColor3 = GREEN}, 3)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "IconHolder"; holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.48); holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.5)
	holder.Parent = cg
	local name = label(cg, {Name = "ItemName", Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.73), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.25)}, 4)
	cg.Parent = slotsFrame
	slots[i] = {cg = cg, scale = sc, odds = odds, holder = holder, name = name, item = nil, pop = 1}
